parameters.query: WITH palabras AS (SELECT DISTINCT p FROM (SELECT unnest(string_to_array(lower(regexp_replace($1::text, '[^a-zA-Z0-9áéíóúüñÁÉÍÓÚÜÑ ]', ' ', 'g')), ' ')) AS p) x WHERE length(p) > 2 AND p !~ '^[0-9]+$' AND p <> ALL (ARRAY['quiero','busco','buscando','necesito','tenes','tenés','tienen','tiene','tenga','hay','libro','libros','regalo','regalar','años','año','chico','chica','chicos','chicas','nene','nena','algo','alguno','alguna','cuanto','cuánto','precio','sale','cuesta','favor','gracias','hola','buenas','buenos','dias','días','tardes','noches','recomendas','recomendás','recomendar','mostrar','mostrame','decime','quisiera','gustaria','gustaría','queria','quería','podes','podés','pueden','ejemplo','tipo','cosa','cosas','soy','dije','sucursal','sucursales','local','locales','donde','dónde','retirar','retiro','horario','horarios','cerca'])), codigos AS (SELECT DISTINCT (regexp_matches(regexp_replace($1::text, '[-\s]', '', 'g'), '(\d{13}|\d{10})', 'g'))[1] AS d), hits AS (SELECT pr.id, 1 AS w FROM productos pr JOIN palabras w ON to_tsvector('spanish', pr.nombre || ' ' || coalesce(pr.marca,'') || ' ' || coalesce(pr.editorial,'') || ' ' || replace(pr.segmento_demo,'_',' ') || ' ' || coalesce(pr.descripcion,'')) @@ plainto_tsquery('spanish', w.p) WHERE pr.negocio_id = $3::int AND pr.canal = ANY(string_to_array($4::text, ',')) UNION ALL SELECT pr.id, 100 FROM productos pr WHERE pr.negocio_id = $3::int AND pr.canal = ANY(string_to_array($4::text, ',')) AND pr.isbn IN (SELECT d FROM codigos)), r AS (SELECT pr.nombre, pr.marca, pr.editorial, pr.canal, pr.segmento_demo AS categoria, pr.precio, pr.stock, pr.url_producto, left(coalesce(pr.descripcion, ''), 220) AS descripcion, sum(h.w) AS score FROM hits h JOIN productos pr ON pr.id = h.id GROUP BY pr.id ORDER BY score DESC, pr.nombre LIMIT 5), s AS (SELECT su.nombre, su.direccion, su.telefono, su.whatsapp FROM sucursales su WHERE su.negocio_id = $3::int AND 'retail' = ANY(string_to_array($4::text, ',')) AND ($1::text ~* '(sucursal|local|donde|dónde|direcci|ubicad|ubicaci|retir|horario|cerca|queda)' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM palabras w WHERE length(w.p) > 3 AND to_tsvector('spanish', su.nombre || ' ' || coalesce(su.direccion,'')) @@ plainto_tsquery('spanish', w.p))) ORDER BY su.nombre LIMIT 10) SELECT coalesce((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('nombre', nombre, 'marca', marca, 'editorial', editorial, 'canal', canal, 'categoria', categoria, 'precio', precio, 'stock', stock, 'url_producto', url_producto, 'descripcion', descripcion) ORDER BY score DESC) FROM r), '[]'::json) AS catalogo, coalesce((SELECT json_agg(s) FROM s), '[]'::json) AS sucursales;
INSERT INTO conversaciones (telefono, mensaje, respuesta, negocio_id, perfil) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::int, $5);

parameters.textBody: Perdón, se me complicó un momento de mi lado. ¿Me lo repetís, por favor?

parameters.query: WITH cod AS (SELECT lower(substring($1::text from '#([A-Za-z0-9_]+)')) AS c), n_cod AS (SELECT n.* FROM negocios n, cod WHERE n.activo AND n.codigo = cod.c), up AS (INSERT INTO sesiones (telefono, negocio_id, inicio) SELECT $2::text, id, now() FROM n_cod ON CONFLICT (telefono) DO UPDATE SET negocio_id = EXCLUDED.negocio_id, perfil_codigo = NULL, inicio = now(), actualizado_en = now() RETURNING negocio_id), n_ses AS (SELECT n.* FROM negocios n JOIN sesiones s ON s.negocio_id = n.id WHERE s.telefono = $2::text AND n.activo), n_def AS (SELECT * FROM negocios WHERE es_default AND activo LIMIT 1) SELECT r.*, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n_cod) THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT s.perfil_codigo FROM sesiones s WHERE s.telefono = $2::text) END AS perfil_codigo, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n_cod) THEN floor(extract(epoch FROM now()))::bigint ELSE (SELECT floor(extract(epoch FROM coalesce(s.inicio, 'epoch'::timestamptz)))::bigint FROM sesiones s WHERE s.telefono = $2::text) END AS sesion FROM (SELECT * FROM n_cod UNION ALL SELECT * FROM n_ses WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n_cod) UNION ALL SELECT * FROM n_def WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n_cod) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n_ses)) r LIMIT 1;

parameters.query: WITH u AS (INSERT INTO sesiones (telefono, negocio_id, perfil_codigo) SELECT $1::text, $3::int, $2::text WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM perfiles WHERE negocio_id = $3::int AND codigo = $2::text) ON CONFLICT (telefono) DO UPDATE SET perfil_codigo = EXCLUDED.perfil_codigo, actualizado_en = now() RETURNING perfil_codigo) SELECT (SELECT perfil_codigo FROM u) AS perfil_codigo;
